summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases, docs entries, and tests (tests/test_lambda.py, tests/test_lambdad.py). Changes are in monai/transforms/utility/array.py, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, and docs/source/transforms.rst. Nothing was committed. Tests, flake8, and black were not run, per the instructions; verification was by reading the diff only. The Lambdad Args section sits in the class docstring per the spec, unlike the file's usual __init__ convention. The spec's iterable-callable acceptance case has no dedicated test, since the test requirements don't list it.
